verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's homepage claims that "Agents monitor your product continuously, surface insights before you think to ask," which is a first-party claim of autonomous background agents. It is a single marketing line, with no documentation on how users configure, schedule or control such automations. Missing for 10: documentation of user-configurable automations or agents, triggers and schedules, actions the automations can take, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
